error.description: All transition are disabled when `error` is true.

errorMessage.description: A field for populating an error message if an error occurs.

stateOrderCounter.description:
Will be incremented every time state changes. This is to be able to differentiate state history if more than 1 automatic transition occurs in a second.
Note: DateTime milliseconds are not persisted.

state.description: The state of this step in the {@link StateMachineHistory}.

updatedBy.description: If null, the new state is set through automatic transition.

transition.description: If null, the new state is set without evaluating any transition conditions.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

attachedFileName.description:
{@link CaseActivity} fetches on field `attachedFileName`, but there is no corresponding field for this type.
Therefore, this field should just be the empty string.

comment.description: Comment added on the state history.

caseCode.description: Brief explanation of what caused the {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}. It needs to be specified while closing the case.

estimatedDowntimeAvoided.description: The estimated downtime avoided by {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}. It can be specified while closing the case.

estimatedEconomicImpact.description:
Covers the production value gained from reduced downtime and the savings from avoiding the cost
of emergency maintenance repairs. It can be specified while closing the case.

title: The {@link StateMachineHistory} for tracking the state transitions of a {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}.
name: CaseStateHistory
